description: This file defines extension methods for configuring ADO.NET clustering within Orleans hosting and client builders. It provides methods to set up clustering options for silos and clients using different configuration delegates, and registers necessary services for ADO.NET clustering.

classes.name: AdoNetHostingExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for configuring ADO.NET based clustering in Orleans silo and client builders.

methods.name: UseAdoNetClustering (ISiloBuilder, Action<AdoNetClusteringSiloOptions>)
methods.description: Configures a silo to use ADO.NET for clustering with custom options provided via a configuration delegate.

methods.name: UseAdoNetClustering (ISiloBuilder, Action<OptionsBuilder<AdoNetClusteringSiloOptions>>)
methods.description: Configures a silo to use ADO.NET for clustering with options configured via OptionsBuilder.

methods.name: UseAdoNetClustering (IClientBuilder, Action<AdoNetClusteringClientOptions>)
methods.description: Configures a client to use ADO.NET for clustering with custom options provided via a configuration delegate.

methods.name: UseAdoNetClustering (IClientBuilder, Action<OptionsBuilder<AdoNetClusteringClientOptions>>)
methods.description: Configures a client to use ADO.NET for clustering with options configured via OptionsBuilder.
